description: Election Commission - Mr. Asanar Fasmeer Of the Knchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office Of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for a local authority, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) as it deals with the composition of an elected body under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
